_comment: Files too heavy to keep in git - GitHub refuses anything over 100 MB, and a 65 MB pack would be committed twice (pack tree plus overlay source). tools/fetch_remote_files.py puts each one where it belongs before anything reads those folders, and refuses any file whose sha256 does not match.

files.reason: requested addition (cobblemon 1.7.3+1.21.1); 122.8 MiB is over GitHub's per-file limit, so it is fetched rather than committed

requested addition (DivineRPG 1.10.9.3): eight dimensions, more than a hundred bosses and mobs, and its own tiers of tools and armour. 63.0 MB, which is why it is fetched rather than committed: in git it would be two copies, the tree and the overlay source, for 126 MB of history that never shrinks. Its neoforge.mods.toml ships with the build placeholders unreplaced, so it declares no loader range at all and loads against any.
Pastel, 91.1 MiB and the heaviest file the upstream pack carries. Fetched rather than committed: it changes with every upstream release and each version would sit in this history for good.
AmbientSounds 6.3.8, 80.9 MiB, added by this build. In git it would be two copies, the tree and the overlay source, for 162 MiB of history that never shrinks.
Alex's Caves 2.0.10, 71.4 MiB, added by this build. Two copies in git for 143 MiB of permanent history; it is on Modrinth and can be fetched instead.
L_Ender's Cataclysm 3.33, 70.0 MiB. Upstream's own mod, kept out of the history because it is large and moves with every release.
The Bumblezone 7.15.3, 66.4 MiB. Upstream's, and one of the ten files that account for a third of what this repository weighs.
Eternal Starlight 0.9.0, 50.7 MiB. Upstream's, over the size where GitHub starts warning.
Deep Aether 1.1.5.1, 44.1 MiB. Upstream's; fetched with the rest of the heavy ones so a fresh clone does not have to carry them.
The Undergarden 0.9.6, 43.2 MiB. Upstream's, and the last of the files worth taking out of the history.
